meta.dc_power: design operating point; non-thermal = e*f at the source port, thermal = heat flow; signed in nominal direction (a->b for edges)
meta.fault_band_power: time-averaged AC power in the ih band at the source port of each link, at the first-failure hour of the headline run (day 137.3)
meta.edges: sibling_edges[parent] = couplings between two children of that parent, grouped by child pair and domain

links.mechanism: chemical (product carried by the let-down stream)
convection (evaporation and contact in the fill)
conduction (steady bearing mounted on the reactor)
radiation (boiler casing next to the deaerator)
